sentence: Level 1 agents can allow training even if the training is over 10 hours per week, as long as all of the following conditions are met: the client resides in an area where there is little or no possibility of employment and has experienced or is expected to experience long weeks of fruitless job search and difficulties in finding employment because of the variable conditions of the labour market; the client is willing to quit the course if it conflicts with a full-time job; the client is capable of working and available to do so, and poses no restriction towards the acceptance of employment.
